title: Oh No! Our Table! It's Broken
blurb: Delivered with the emotional register of somebody discovering a war crime, about a table. The entire joke lives in that gap: the line reading belongs in a courtroom drama and the subject matter is a piece of flat-pack furniture with a broken leg. Years later it still works, because nobody has ever managed to say it in a normal voice. Deploy it for minor property damage of every kind — a chipped mug, a scratched car door, a shelf that was always going to come off that wall eventually.
origin: From a viral clip of extremely dramatic furniture grief.
